entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today with your VeloFit product?
My VeloBand GPS tracker isn't working. I need to return it.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The pulse reader is complete garbage. It's wildly inaccurate. I'm done with it.

I see. I understand that can be frustrating. We do have a technical support team that can walk through a sensor recalibration. It often resolves accuracy issues. Would you be open to me transferring you?
No. I don't have time for all that. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. Can I get the order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... One moment. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago, on January 5th. Let me just review the policy for you.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return period. I cannot approve that return for you right now.

I've just processed it. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the band, the full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
